title: OurEventRing COPPA Pool Schema
description: BigQuery table schema for the COPPA regulatory pool. Parental consent framework, no behavioral profiling of minors, separate encryption keys.
declined_by: OCR_STANDARD_declinedRegimes.md (ratified 2026-09-04). COPPA under-13 child data, including parental-clearance mechanics, is off the books — a declined regime, not a tier OCR matures into. This schema is retained as a record of what is refused, NOT a roadmap commitment. No OCR product routes writes to oureventring_coppa; OSE phaseToPool() refuses legal_clearance_tier 5 (OSE-1220).

events.description: Core event records for COPPA-regulated events (schools, youth programs). No individual minor data stored — event-level only.

additional_fields.name: age_group
additional_fields.description: Age bracket (under_13, 13_to_17, mixed). Never individual ages.

additional_fields.name: parental_consent_batch_id
additional_fields.description: Reference to batch parental consent record for the program.

additional_fields.name: participant_count
additional_fields.description: Aggregate count only. No individual tracking.

qr_scans.description: QR scan events in COPPA context. Scans are counted at aggregate level only. No individual minor session tracking.
qr_scans.note: No anonymous_session_id in COPPA pool. Scans are event-level, not session-level. No individual minor tracking.

consent_records.description: Parental consent tracking for COPPA compliance.

fields.name: consent_method
fields.description: How consent was obtained (signed_form, email_verification, etc).

fields.name: participant_count
fields.description: Number of minors covered. Aggregate only.

access_audit_log.description: COPPA-mandated audit log. Every access to minor-related data is logged.

de_identification_pipeline.description: Aggregation with minimum group thresholds. No individual minor identifiable in output. Groups below threshold are suppressed entirely.
de_identification_pipeline.suppression_rule: If event participant_count < 10, event is excluded from aggregate contribution entirely.
de_identification_pipeline.output_format: corridor-level event counts and category distributions only
